description: mod-inventory-update deployment configuration. Reference baseline: Trillium bugfest with 3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants. Resource and JVM defaults follow https://folio-org.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/REL/pages/1034125338. Environment-specific database settings and secrets must be supplied at deployment; optional database tuning retains folio-vertx-lib 4.0.1 and Vert.x 5.0.4 defaults. While the baseline table’s declares two instances, this configuration only declares one replica since the import APIs do not support multiple instances, as also stated in the README. Sidecar resources and JVM settings use the baseline table’s generic sidecar defaults; sidecar environment variables are owned by folio-module-sidecar.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: Container CPU allocation in ECS CPU units (1024 units = 1 vCPU); bugfest default for modules without a CPU override.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Container memory hard limit in MiB, matching the Trillium bugfest baseline.

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Container memory reservation in MiB, matching the Trillium bugfest baseline.

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size, matching the Trillium bugfest baseline.

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size, matching the Trillium bugfest baseline.

deployment.description: Import APIs do not support multiple running instances (README Deployment note); use one replica and avoid overlapping replicas during rollout, despite the baseline table listing two instances.

kong.description: Connect and send use standard Kong timeouts; allow 120 seconds for synchronous inventory batch updates, following the implementation guide’s general recommendation; tune for the longest legitimate request.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the container launcher, matching the bugfest heap and metaspace defaults in the java section; overrides the descriptor’s percentage-based heap setting.

EnvVars.name: VERTICLE_FILE
EnvVars.description: Application jar filename set by Dockerfile for the container launcher.

EnvVars.name: VERTICLE_HOME
EnvVars.description: Application jar directory set by Dockerfile for the container launcher.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host supplied by the deployment. Supports {tenant} substitution.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port; standard Vert.x PostgreSQL client default.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name supplied by the deployment. Supports {tenant} substitution.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL username supplied through deployment secret management. Supports {tenant} substitution.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password supplied through deployment secret management; no credentials are stored here.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per pool; Vert.x PoolOptions default. folio-vertx-lib shares pools for equal connection options across tenants within the process.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of retries after a failed database connection attempt; Vert.x default disables retries.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Delay in milliseconds between database reconnect attempts; Vert.x default. Relevant when DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS is positive.

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: Optional PEM CA certificate chain. When supplied, folio-vertx-lib enables VERIFY_FULL, HTTPS hostname verification and TLSv1.3. Leave unset to retain the default connection options.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum pooled connection lifetime in milliseconds; folio-vertx-lib explicitly defaults to 30 minutes.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: Sidecar CPU allocation in ECS CPU units; bugfest default for sidecars without a CPU override.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Sidecar memory hard limit in MiB, matching the generic bugfest sidecar baseline.

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Sidecar memory reservation in MiB, matching the generic bugfest sidecar baseline.

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum sidecar Java heap size, matching the generic bugfest sidecar baseline.

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum sidecar Java metaspace size, matching the generic bugfest sidecar baseline.
